# Introduction

Compositional generalisation—the capacity to comprehend and produce novel combinations of familiar primitives—remains a fundamental challenge for deep neural networks [@lake2018generalization].

# Theoretical Framework: The $\Sigma$-Model

We formulate training dynamics as a coupled dynamical system:
\begin{align}
\frac{dD}{dt} &= f(D, S; \alpha, \beta) \\
\frac{dS}{dt} &= g(D, S; \gamma, \sigma)
\end{align}
where $D$ denotes depth accumulation and $S$ denotes schema coherence.

# Numerical Simulations & Empirical Findings

Using high-precision adaptive ODE solvers and discrete transformer evaluations, we identify a stable attractor state termed the **$\sigma$-trap**.
